name: ui-canvas-2d
description: Canvas2d — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui canvas-2d pattern).

schema.description: Canvas2d — UI factory (1:1 with the @almadar/ui canvas-2d pattern).
schema.name: ui-canvas-2d

ariaBusy.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.
ariaBusy.label: Aria-busy

ariaCurrent.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.
ariaCurrent.label: Aria-current

ariaDescribedby.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).
ariaDescribedby.label: Aria-describedby

ariaExpanded.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.
ariaExpanded.label: Aria-expanded

ariaHidden.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).
ariaHidden.label: Aria-hidden

ariaLabel.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).
ariaLabel.label: Aria-label

ariaLabelledby.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.
ariaLabelledby.label: Aria-labelledby

ariaLive.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.
ariaLive.label: Aria-live

ariaSelected.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).
ariaSelected.label: Aria-selected

backgroundImage.description: Background image (tiled behind iso/hex/flat/free; cover-scaled for atlas slices). A bare URL string is accepted as shorthand for a standalone backdrop.
backgroundImage.label: Background Image

bgColor.description: Solid backdrop colour — the base layer under any `backgroundImage`.
bgColor.label: Bg Color

cameraPos.description: Initial camera position in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.pos`). The host projects this to screen space and centers the viewport on it for the first render; ignored once the user pans or a follow target takes over.
cameraPos.label: Camera Pos

children.description: Declarative JSX drawable children (`<DrawShape .../>` composed in paint order). When `drawables` is empty, each child registers its descriptor via the drawable registry context and the host paints them.
children.label: Children

description.description: Text alternative for the scene, rendered as visually hidden text and linked by aria-describedby.
description.label: Description

dir.description: Text direction of this element's content.
dir.label: Dir

editable.description: --- Scene-edit mode (a game studio selecting/dragging drawables). Purely
editable.label: Editable

enter.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.
enter.label: Enter

enterDelay.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.
enterDelay.label: Enter Delay

fit.description: Auto-fit the board's grid extent to the viewport (default false — boards render at their authored `scale` and overflow → pan). Opt in for whole-board-overview boards. User wheel/pinch zoom always wins after the initial fit.
fit.label: Fit

followTarget.description: Follow-camera target in scene space (the neutral core `Camera.target`). When `camera:'follow'` the host lerps to keep this point centered.
followTarget.label: Follow Target

keyMap.description: Maps a keydown `e.code` — optionally prefixed `Mod+` (⌘/Ctrl), `Shift+`, `Alt+` in that order — to the board's SEMANTIC event (device-agnostic input), emitted as `UI:{event}`; keystrokes inside inputs/textareas never route.
keyMap.label: Key Map

keyUpMap.description: Maps a keyup `e.code` — optionally prefixed `Mod+` (⌘/Ctrl), `Shift+`, `Alt+` in that order — to the board's SEMANTIC event, emitted as `UI:{event}`; keystrokes inside inputs/textareas never route.
keyUpMap.label: Key Up Map

lang.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).
lang.label: Lang

moveEvent.description: Declarative move event, `UI:{moveEvent} { id, x, y }` — fired once on drop.
moveEvent.label: Move Event

onMove.description: Fired once per drag gesture, on drop — before `moveEvent`.
onMove.label: On Move

onSelect.description: Fired on a click that changes selection — before `selectEvent`.
onSelect.label: On Select

role.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.
role.label: Role

scale.description: Render scale, legacy-squared semantics: on-screen cell ≈ `256 × scale²` px (the authored contract every board tuned its value for). Converted internally to the single camera zoom against the board's native tile width, so the cell pitch follows the asset while the on-screen size stays as authored. Ignored when `fit` is on; passed through raw for `free`/`side` (world-pixel-direct).
scale.label: Scale

tabIndex.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.
tabIndex.label: Tab Index

tileHoverEvent.description: Emits UI:{tileHoverEvent} with the unprojected scene { x, y } on hover.
tileHoverEvent.label: Tile Hover Event

tileLeaveEvent.description: Emits UI:{tileLeaveEvent} with {} on pointer leave.
tileLeaveEvent.label: Tile Leave Event

tileWidth.description: Native tile/cell width in source px for this board's asset (e.g. 16 for Kenney tiny-dungeon, ~128 for iso blocks). The grid cell pitch follows the asset, so tile textures map 1:1 (crisp, no stretch). Defaults to the detected atlas tile width, else 256.
tileWidth.label: Tile Width

unitClickEvent.description: Unit-click event. The neutral drawable host cannot resolve a click to a per-entity id (descriptors carry only a `ScenePos`, no id), so this prop is accepted but not yet emitted — the id-hit-test is a tracked fork (docs/Almadar_Std_Game_V2_PLAN.md).
unitClickEvent.label: Unit Click Event

emits.description: Unit-click event. The neutral drawable host cannot resolve a click to a per-entity id (descriptors carry only a `ScenePos`, no id), so this prop is accepted but not yet emitted — the id-hit-test is a tracked fork (docs/Almadar_Std_Game_V2_PLAN.md).
Emits UI:{tileHoverEvent} with the unprojected scene { x, y } on hover.
Emits UI:{tileLeaveEvent} with {} on pointer leave.
Fired on a click that changes selection — before `selectEvent`.
Fired once per drag gesture, on drop — before `moveEvent`.

events.description: Unit-click event. The neutral drawable host cannot resolve a click to a per-entity id (descriptors carry only a `ScenePos`, no id), so this prop is accepted but not yet emitted — the id-hit-test is a tracked fork (docs/Almadar_Std_Game_V2_PLAN.md).
events.name: @config.unit click event

events.description: Emits UI:{tileHoverEvent} with the unprojected scene { x, y } on hover.
events.name: @config.tile hover event

events.description: Emits UI:{tileLeaveEvent} with {} on pointer leave.
events.name: @config.tile leave event

events.description: Fired on a click that changes selection — before `selectEvent`.
events.name: @config.on select

events.description: Fired once per drag gesture, on drop — before `moveEvent`.
events.name: @config.on move
